page.layout: One text column with running head at top; page number top right; a horizontal rule separates the running text from the new chapter, which begins below it with a centred heading and a drop-cap paragraph. No marginal notes. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: ventu sanguinis humani, & quarum exitus, etiam ipsi vi-ctori sunt luctuosi. Tales autem sunt exitus singulari certa-mine contendentium. Si enim innocens nocentem interemerit, tantum se innocentem probavit, & tamen per cædem humanam, in causâ[?], in quâ si ipse convictus, forte in multam quam condemnatus fuisset.
Quod si nocens innocen-tem necaverit, quàm non lu-ctuosum erit, hominem non tantum ab homine per calum-niam accusari, sed insuper & vita, & fama simul, saltem hominum opinione privari.
main_text.head: CAPUT VII. An quis licitè acceptet conditionem certaminis singularis, si sit innocens & adversarius calumniator?
main_text.p: ETiamsi qui non jure incusatur, certò persuasus sit.

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment ("ventu") and is kept as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. "causâ" and its accent are uncertain and marked [?]. The catchword "in-" is at the foot right and is kept out of the text. The drop cap "E" is joined to "Tiamsi" as "ETiamsi". The long s is written as plain s throughout. The faint watermark at the lower right is the digitiser's mark and is not transcribed.
